protocol.authority: Research only; no monitoring, promotion, funding or broker action.
protocol.question: Do the sealed short-range and long-range GLD lifecycle signals generalise across the 52-ETF audited pool, and does a two-horizon lifecycle asset-selection rule beat the current FR25 SOTA after costs?

data.basis: Pinned published audited adjusted OHLC and raw volume; the 52-asset panel and the FR25 target weights are the frozen v2 pool inputs repriced on the same batch. No online prices, filling or splicing.

methodology.per_asset_fit: Each ETF gets an independent pre-2023 fit in each structural domain: 200 random bounded vectors + the sealed GLD vector + 40 anchor mutations, screened at 5bp; the top 15 replayed across 5/10/20bp and +1 session delay; evidence requires >=5 closed IS episodes and >=5% exposure; the best final score is sealed per ETF/domain.
methodology.transfer_fallback: ETFs with fewer than 500 evaluable IS sessions use the sealed GLD vector for that domain (no per-asset fit).
methodology.signals: Sleeve state and extension score ((close - frozen trigger)/ATR) are causal daily outputs; the portfolio window uses only these pre-2023-fitted signals.
selection_rules: R1 lifecycle top-six: among ETFs with a short/long sleeve active at the month-end close, keep positive 126-session momentum, rank by combined extension score, take up to six, inverse-vol (63-session) weights, 45% cap, 98% budget, cash remainder.
R2 lifecycle top-six without the 126-session momentum gate.
R3 lifecycle allocation: all active ETFs, weight = combined sleeve exposure x inverse-vol, 45% cap, 98% budget.
R4 lifecycle-gated momentum: among active ETFs, rank by 126-session momentum.
Event controls: mandatory adoption on any held-name lifecycle exit or when the L1 target change including cash exceeds 0.10, plus monthly anchors.
Tilt: 80% frozen FR25 targets + 20% lifecycle rule target, monthly rebalanced.
methodology.no_oos_tuning: Rules, caps, weights and frictions are predeclared; 2023+ outcomes are not used to choose a weight, threshold or rule.

limitations: Per-ETF fits use a deliberately smaller search budget than the GLD deep dives; the purpose is breadth across the pool, not an optimum per ETF.
The 2023-2026 interval has been inspected in prior research; all OOS results are development retests, not untouched holdouts.
FR25 and M1 benchmark paths are frozen replays of their own decisions on the same batch; the FR25 target-weight matrix was reproduced exactly by the shared engine.
One current-vintage provider cohort; no historical universe or publication-vintage certification. Cash earns zero; close decisions fill at the next open.
